correctness.rationale: For positive a,K,h, exponentials of the two nilpotent shear parts are elementary and yield the two displayed unimodular undamped matrices. Their fair average of Gram matrices is exactly (1+s^4/2)I, proving the all-n squared-energy law by conditioning. Frozen orders have equal unimodular characteristic polynomial λ²-(2-s²)λ+1; the Jordan boundary s=2 is damped. The strict comparison is equivalent to the sign of a cubic via the monotonic map u+1/u, and f(4)<0, f(8)>0 and f″>0 beyond 4 prove uniqueness. Exact witnesses establish both sides. A separate standard-library checker executes 193 checks, including finite exhaustive history enumeration, but analytic lemmas establish the infinite statements.

value.rationale: Long-time numerical stability is a central design concern when independently randomizing operator order. Here the complete exact ODE is a damped rotation and either fixed splitting order has identical spectrum, yet random iid interleaving can be either strictly more or strictly less stable in the precise mean-square sense; the universal unique crossover and two strict rational examples are motivated boundaries, not arbitrary parameter recomputations. The simple 2x2 witness makes the failure of frozen-order stability tests for randomized compositions directly reusable.
